reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is vague and lacks a specific, physically grounded mechanism linking SRO to simultaneous improvements in all four properties, and it ignores well-known trade-offs (e.g., strength vs. ductility).
reasons.testability: The proposed test is circular (falsified if properties don't improve) and lacks a decisive, measurable criterion; 'optimized SRO' is not defined, making the test non-specific.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is too generic to guide a researcher, merely stating that optimizing SRO and microstructure will improve properties without specifying how or which alloy system.
